description: SLA - Déploiement du haut et très haut débit is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ARCEP. The dataset has been filtered to the member municipalities of Saint-Louis Agglomération.Below, the description of these data for all these data (France scale). This dataset details the progress of the deployment of broadband and very high speed, in France, by municipality. Coverage: ARCEP. The portal shows the English title as "SLA – Deployment of broadband and very high speed" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ARCEP. Its keywords include logement, ftth, fibre. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-10-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
